name: For My Man
description: A true crime series featuring the salacious and shocking stories of women who have been arrested for a crime they did in the name of love. From a killing spree across the mid-west to being an inside informant at the DEA and from murdering an unsupportive mother to robbing fifteen banks in under a year, these women have no limits as to how far they’ll go for their men.

videos.title: Yvette Gay / Vishawn Mills
videos.overview: Women who committed a crime in the name of love are the focus. In the opener, Yvette Gay is drawn into a murderous plot; Vishawn Mills covers up a murder committed by her boyfriend. [also shown as S1:E3]

videos.title: Debra Brown / Chakkira Wonnum
videos.overview: Shy, anonymous 20-year-old Debra Brown falls for serial child predator, Alton Coleman, and gets pulled into his twisted, deadly world. Teenager Chakkira Wonnum escapes an abusive home and runs into the arms of a dangerous drug dealer and addict who forces her to commit an unspeakable act.

videos.title: Vanessa Coleman / Tamika Jasper-Barbary
videos.overview: Vanessa Coleman, dangerously in love, watches as her man tortures a couple while in a drug-induced rage. When her man's job gets them in hot water, Tamika Jasper-Barbary risks it all to save her love as she tries to use her government job to help her drug-trafficking husband. [also shown as S1:E4]

videos.title: Angel Glenn / Carolyn King
videos.overview: Teen mom, Angel Glenn, crosses paths with a bad boy who lives a life of crime. Troubled housewife Carolyn King deserts her family in search of a clean slate, only to find her perfect match in a local convict Bradley Martin. [also shown as S1:E5]

videos.title: Felicia Scott / Victoria Jackson
videos.overview: Felicia Scott goes into a homicidal tailspin when her man demands a child she can't give him; Victoria Jackson betrays her family at her jealous man's request. [also shown as S1:E1]

videos.title: Jessica Delancy / Lisa Toney
videos.overview: Jessica Delancy plots to have her husband blown away. Lisa Toney and her hot-tempered boyfriend hand out a gruesome punishment when someone messes with their money.

videos.title: Tia Skinner / Renyatta Hamilton
videos.overview: Teenager Tia Skinner seeks revenge on her parents when they forbid her from seeing her boyfriend and orchestrates a violent attempt at emancipation. 20-year-old Renyatta Hamilton, a love-drunk girl, desperately tries to please her boyfriend, even at the expense of an innocent admirer.

videos.title: Verna McClain / Shaketa Jones
videos.overview: Verna McClain falls hard for a young handsome stud, and her desire to hold his attention will drive her to commit a horrifying act. Next, Shaketa Jones becomes infatuated with Sunday school's new bad boy; his drug habit forces her into a life of crime.

videos.title: Felicia Blakely / Kiesha Smith
videos.overview: Felicia Blakely, a 16-year old stripper, falls for a pimp and is forced to choose between saving her own life or taking another's. Kiesha Smith and new love Mike Mitchell, a modern day Bonnie & Clyde, hit a dangerous crossroad.

videos.title: Tosha Dunigan / Connie Ikpoh
videos.overview: When Tosha Dunagin gets fired from her job at a massage parlor, she lets her boyfriend coax her into committing a revenge robbery with deadly results. In Los Angeles, Connie Ikpoh puts her faith in her pastor husband who pulls her into a multi-million dollar fraud scheme.

videos.title: Jean Brown / Natalie Johnson
videos.overview: An act of betrayal threatens to derail a drug ring run by Jean Brown and her husband Carl Smith, and turns til death do us part from a vow into a threat. Single mom Natalie Johnson's efforts  to help her boyfriend steal from a neighbor has violent consequences.

videos.title: Cadedra Cook / Desiree Satterwhite
videos.overview: Georgia teenager Cadedra Cook falls for a young man whose reckless ways put her at the center of a bloody crime scene. Desiree Satterwhite falls under the influence of a man almost twice her age and walks away from her life to become his partner in a dangerous armed robbery spree across North Central Texas.

videos.title: Walker/Mack
videos.overview: When Olivia Walker meets a greed-stricken man, she agrees to make a hefty withdrawal in exchange for a fairytale ending. Next, a luxurious vacation for two turns into a tragedy for three.

videos.title: Forsythe/Pulliam
videos.overview: Jennifer Forsythe helps a convicted felon escape from prison; Latasha shares her toxic desires with a man she meets and the couple becomes enveloped in a drug-fueled world.

videos.title: Green/Santos
videos.overview: A man leads Shavontae Green down a dark path after a life-changing move to Nebraska; an Ohio woman, Latesha Santos, is driven to do something unthinkable by her boyfriend to prove her loyalty.

videos.title: Paz/Brimble
videos.overview: Veronica Paz is a beauty with a high school football star boyfriend but when another man comes between them she must make a deadly choice for the one she loves. Next, a woman is willing to kill for her husband.

videos.title: Nelson/Williams
videos.overview: A Mississippi woman, Kathleen Nelson, gets trapped in a deadly feud. Cara's love for a charming marine leads her to a dead end.

videos.title: Owens/Rush
videos.overview: Jennifer Owens' dream job as a female guard turns into a nightmare when she is seduced by an inmate and begins smuggling drugs for him; Kenisa Rush leads her boyfriend to plot a robbery, but things go horribly wrong.

videos.title: Hudson/O'Neal
videos.overview: Danielle struggles to make ends meet when she falls in love, gets caught in a con man's scheme and may get burned; Sonya O'Neal and her partner in crime run the street in Detroit until a new threat emerges.

videos.title: Leung/Bunton
videos.overview: A New York teen, Connie Leung, goes from homework to homicide when she gets involved with an older man who pulls her into his murder plans. Next, Karen Bunton tries to help cover her boyfriend's heinous crimes.

videos.title: Roosa/Hayes
videos.overview: Patricia Roosa's love is tested by her boyfriend; Amanda Hayes' dreams of stardom are extinguished when she finds darkness in her husband, Grant.

videos.title: Edwards/Jones
videos.overview: Cheari Edwards joins forces with her boyfriend in a killer plan to make quick cash; Vernell Jones hunts down her exes after she falls for a man with a jealous streak.

videos.title: Williams/Donoho
videos.overview: Annette Williams falls into a depression tailspin thinking about losing her man over infertility problems; Krysta Donoho lives a nightmare with her devilish Romeo and is forced to prove her worth.

videos.title: King/Maraglino
videos.overview: Courtney's dreams go up in smoke after being led into fire by her man; Dorothy's man thrusts her head first into a world of pain.

videos.title: Dunn/Hope
videos.overview: Jodi Dunn gets caught in a turf war with deadly consequences. Later, Kendra Hope jeopardizes her future to help her man in a cover-up.

videos.title: Barrett/Matheny
videos.overview: Alyssa Barrett's teenage pregnancy sparks a feud amongst a family; Tiana Matheny fights against a man who pulls her into a dark scheme.

videos.title: Hamm/Barber
videos.overview: Amanda Hamm protects her dangerous lover risking her children's lives. Later, April Barber lights her life on fire to keep her child and her man.

videos.title: Pike/Hairston
videos.overview: Christa Pike follows her man into the heart of darkness; Selena Hairston bites the hand of the man that feeds her.

videos.title: Gilmer/Holmes
videos.overview: T'Keisha Gilmer pays the price for love by making a big sacrifice; Brandy Holmes teams up with a criminal bad boy to prove her deadly devotion.

videos.title: Henry/Ervin
videos.overview: When Belinda Henry, a lonely divorcee, meets aspiring model, Keith Henry, her way of life shifts from pain to pleasure. Later, young love turns deadly when seemingly dreamy Keithron Fields walks into studious Ashley Ervin’s life.

videos.title: Frank/Pedroza
videos.overview: A police officer falls for a street thug and commits the most heinous bloodbath in New Orleans' history; a teen falls for a local bad boy.

videos.title: Martinez/Rembert
videos.overview: A woman falls for her college sweetheart and helps him with a get-rich-quick scheme; a teen gets involved with a manipulative pimp.

videos.title: Smith/Young
videos.overview: A young belle meets a handsome suitor and uses her sexual prowess to set a trap; a suburban housewife uproots her simple life for a flame.

videos.title: Brantley/Miller
videos.overview: A woman falls hard for a street-smart man who puts her loyalty to the test; a young woman gets her hands dirty for her sexy handyman.

videos.title: Harvey/Green
videos.overview: A teen mom must decide if her man comes before her family after a lethal showdown; a budding online romance spins out of control.

videos.title: Warrior/Jernigan
videos.overview: A woman who wants everything and more juggles her husband and another man; while another woman meets a churchgoing man who proves to be more dangerous beneath the surface.

videos.title: Roland/Nash
videos.overview: A woman faces a challenge when her man's plan for cash ends in bloodshed; a cross-dressing teen takes his underage boyfriend on a road trip.

videos.title: McCarty/Harden
videos.overview: Single mom, LaCarla McCarty, falls for an ex-con and becomes entangled in a deadly scheme for cash. Later, Akeita Harden tries desperately to hold onto her dangerous man and lavish life.

videos.title: Reeve/Fulbright
videos.overview: A book smart lover's jailhouse romance turns deadly; a beauty queen's dream of becoming a lawyer crumbles when a love triangle unravels.

videos.title: Kemp/Jacobs
videos.overview: Abby Kemp falls for a man who introduces her to robbery; a mother, Cierra Jacobs, must choose between the man she loves and the only man to ever support her.

videos.title: Atkinson/Young
videos.overview: Single parent Dominique Atkinson is looking for love when she is introduced to Marquis Cheatham, a cocky young Marine. When their romance starts to brew, she finds out he’s married and the new couple devises a plan to eliminate his wife.  Later, Destiny Young falls for a criminal and gets wrapped up in a crime spree.

videos.title: Thomas/Leja
videos.overview: Shante Thomas, the perfect daughter, had everything going for her until she met DeAndre Minkens and became part of a deadly plan that changes her life forever. Later, Tina Leja’s jailhouse romance with Darnell Smith sparks a jealous rage that leads to murder.

videos.title: Simonee/Mason
videos.overview: Long Islander Shatura Simonee’s forbidden affairs lead to a deadly family confrontation. Later, Adriana Mason wants to impress her new dealer boyfriend by helping him steal back his drug money.

videos.title: Roberts/DeJesus
videos.overview: When Donna Roberts falls for a man half her age, there’s adventure and excitement in her newfound love - the only thing in their way is her husband. Later, Alisa DeJesus and her man are pregnant and homeless. Desperate, they hail a taxi, but with no money to pay it turns into a drive through hell.

videos.title: Helmedach/Williams
videos.overview: Jennifer Helmedach and her love's attempt to rob a friend ends in tragedy; Lashonda Williams' entanglement in a world filled with sex crimes ends in bloodshed in Memphis.

videos.title: Dashiell/Watson
videos.overview: Keeairra Dashiell was your typical girl next door until she met football star, Tyquan Knox, who tackled her heart and convinced her to do the unthinkable. Later, Shameeka Watson’s fiery temper leads her and her husband, Clarence McCord III, to commit a horrendous murder.

videos.title: Jacobs/Wortham
videos.overview: After falling mysteriously ill, Tiffani Jacobs is looking for a man to help her feel normal. But her dreams are shattered when the quest for true love drives her to do the unthinkable. And in Spokane, Washington, wild child Jackie Wortham scorches a path of destruction with a lover who fuels her fire.

videos.title: Feazell/Williams-Irby
videos.overview: Shakina Feazell finds love while struggling with addiction; Tonie Marie Williams-Irby's new love wants to steal more than her heart.

videos.title: Pugh/Mathurin
videos.overview: After a tumultuous childhood, Erica Pugh longs to break free from her parent's strict rules; Yamiley Mathurin's lover derails her promising future.

videos.title: Granger/Blanchard
videos.overview: Alexis Granger's future is bright until her passion for a pimp puts her on a sinful path in the Bible Belt; Desirae Blanchard struggles to find her place in the world until true love sweeps her off her feet.

videos.title: Brundage/Harris
videos.overview: Jennifer Brundage finds the love of her life, then distance threatens to keep them apart, and she goes to great lengths to hold on to her man; Chade Harris always plays by the rules until she meets a man who takes her on an unlawful ride.

videos.title: Thompson/McKibben
videos.overview: When Jemeker Thompson falls for an LA baller, she takes the throne as "Queen Pin," but after rising to the top of an illicit game, only love can strike her down. And later, in Indianapolis, Haley Mckibben lives on her own terms until she falls for a bad-boy who leads her into a world of violence and deceit.

videos.title: Humphrey/Ingram
videos.overview: Brenda Humphrey falls for a man with a criminal past, but when things don’t go as planned, she goes to great lengths to keep her man happy. And later, Jinea Ingram never wants for a great time, until she falls for a man who assigns her to his thievish plan.

videos.title: Dixon/Huber
videos.overview: Kayla Dixon scrambles at a fighting chance to survive her youth, but the safety net she finds in her new man comes at a deadly cost; Eileen Huber falls for her former classmate and he leads her on a torturous rampage sweeping the San Gabriel Valley.

videos.title: Paige/Brown
videos.overview: Growing up on the rough streets of Baltimore, aspiring nurse Labria Paige manages to rise above the odds; in Savannah, GA, a couple risks it all for love when their crime spree takes a deadly turn.

videos.title: Evans/Simpson
videos.overview: Texas duo Damonica Evans and Brandon Daniels look for a fresh start, then a get-rich-quick scheme goes awry; teenager Jennifer Simpson's loving husband ropes her into a heinous crime that changes their small town forever.

videos.title: Middleton/Costantini
videos.overview: When Marryssa Middleton's lover shows his true colors, it's too late for her to get out; Melanie Costantini moves to Sin City with her high school sweetheart in search of a fresh start.

videos.title: McFarland/Harris
videos.overview: Single mother Sheila McFarland meets local drug hustler Eddie "The Man" Brownlee and her world is thrown off kilter; in Georgia, a couple risks it all when a botched robbery leaves them high and dry.

videos.title: Pugh/Harris
videos.overview: Kiesha Pugh meets a man who becomes the sunshine of her life, but, when money runs low, she winds up in a deadly scheme; Tonisha Harris turns over a new leaf to provide for her family then her man asks her to help clean up his dirty deeds.

videos.title: Fingal/Pannell-Brown
videos.overview: In Kansas, teenager Eboni Fingal puts her promising future in jeopardy when she falls for the wrong man; in Maryland, Larlane Pannell-Brown has the perfect life and husband, but she'll do anything to hold on to her new younger man.

videos.title: Claude/Arnold
videos.overview: Tennessee native Vanessa Claude falls for a man with a devious plan and ends up having a night she'll never forget; in Calumet, IL, Mary Ann Arnold refuses to share her man and she'll move heaven and earth to keep another woman at bay.

videos.title: King/Beasley
videos.overview: In Maryland, single mother Kimberly King struggles financially, but her infatuation with a younger man blinds her to his cruelty and greed; in Georgia, orphan Brittney Beasley stops at nothing to secure her and her lover's future.

videos.title: Jones/Binyard
videos.overview: In Alabama, abused teenager Ashley Jones finds stability with bad boy Geramie Hart and she'll go to extreme measures to keep him; in Michigan, a ride-or-die couple falls when numerous armed robberies guide police directly to their doorstep.

videos.title: George/Alfonso
videos.overview: Pensacola, FL, native Stephanie George places her trust in an ex and gambles with her entire future; in Sin City, Yenesis Alfonso loves the glitter and gold her man provides but their lavish lifestyle goes up in flames.

videos.title: Housley/Woods
videos.overview: Althea Housley struggles to put food on the table, so when her soul mate reveals a plan to make their dreams come true, she can't deny him; Jeri Woods demonstrates to her 10 children how loyal they must be to her domineering husband.

videos.title: Forbes/Cervantez
videos.overview: Chicwanda Forbes gets the attention she craves from an older man in exchange for her loyalty; Carter Carol Cervantez begins to rethink her priorities when she finds love at the workplace.

videos.title: Bynum/Roberts
videos.overview: Dorthia Bynum is looking for someone to heal her emotional scars; later, when a couple holds a young boy hostage, it leads them all on a terrifying journey from which there's no return.

videos.title: Holling/Hood
videos.overview: In Ohio, Sandra Holling always falls for the wrong type of man, then she falls for the ultimate bad boy, joining him in his deadly fantasies; in Athens, GA, Briana Hood truly believes she has married the love of her life.

videos.title: Johnson/Riordan
videos.overview: Ciera Johnson lives a righteous life, but she goes to extremes to prove her love for her boyfriend; Krystal Riordan goes from rags to riches when she is adopted by a loving family.

videos.title: Gordon/Sheppard
videos.overview: Leslie Gordon hopes that a vacation with her man will bring them closer together, but he lets her in on a devilish plan, turning her dream getaway into a nightmare. Later, Erica Sheppard runs away from an abusive relationship with her ex.

videos.title: Owens/Eason
videos.overview: Teenage mother Ashley Owens struggles to make ends meet until she falls for a bad boy who has a plan to get some easy cash; Nicole Eason dreams of giving her husband a family and uses deceit to fill their home with children.

videos.title: Bound by Blood
videos.overview: Random shootings on Christmas Day strike fear in the hearts of citizens in Dayton, Ohio; police uncover evidence that the crimes may be connected to a band of young killers whose thirst for blood results from a teenage romance gone wrong.

videos.title: Love on the Run
videos.overview: A young model meets a handsome man while grieving for her late father, and her future suddenly seems brighter; soon, she finds herself following this charmer down a dark road, destroying anyone who gets in their way, all in the name of love.

videos.title: The Wrong Mr. Right
videos.overview: A double homicide in a California neighborhood leaves investigators tracking a case with more questions than answers; when a high-speed car chase leads them to a pretty young woman, it is clear she is willing to do wrong to impress her Mr. Right.

videos.title: Circle of Trust
videos.overview: A close-knit community is gripped with fear after two families are found brutally murdered; as police seek to unravel the mystery, it leads them down a trail of lies, proving no one can be trusted, even loved ones.

videos.title: Fanning the Flames
videos.overview: After an 18-year-old woman is gunned down in cold blood, detectives discover a mysterious man has been pitting the shooter and the victim against each other.

videos.title: In Too Deep
videos.overview: When the bodies of a missing couple surface in the waters around New Orleans, detectives wonder who could have committed such a heinous crime.

videos.title: Happily Ever After
videos.overview: A mother of three is beaten and stabbed multiple times in her own home, and police are desperate to make sense of her killing.

videos.title: Living a Lie
videos.overview: After a newborn baby girl vanishes from the hospital without a trace, people are galvanized into a nationwide search to find her.

videos.title: Driven to the Edge
videos.overview: Detroit is shaken to the core after a well-respected community member is gunned down during a robbery.

videos.title: Deadly Devotion
videos.overview: In Burlington, N.C., gunfire erupts at a park killing a 21-year-old man; police are shocked when their investigation leads them to a "good girl" whose love for a "bad boy" has pushed her into a violent world of vice.

videos.title: No Good Deed Goes Unpunished
videos.overview: A church deacon is found dead after an apartment fire, and the evidence points to foul play.

videos.title: Baited by Love
videos.overview: A beautiful college student falls under the spell of a so-called bad boy; during their whirlwind romance, he encourages her to join him in engaging in criminal activities.

videos.title: Young and Naive
videos.overview: A teenage girl falls for a handsome older man, then a gruesome discovery reveals that this love story has a dark side; before long, police are on the trail of a teen who will go to any lengths to be with her man.

videos.title: Lost in Loyalty
videos.overview: A heartbroken young mother is elated to get a second chance at love, then she discovers that her dream man has a dark side; before long, she finds her life in pieces as she sets out to prove she's the ride-or-die woman her new man demands.

videos.title: Loving in Fear
videos.overview: A beautiful college student drops everything to run away with her new man, only to return home nine months later with a shocking story about a brutal murder, a drug kingpin and the destructive desire at the center of her secret life.

videos.title: Flirting With Danger
videos.overview: A frantic 911 call leads investigators to the scene of a brutal double homicide outside of Atlanta; as police hunt for clues, a run-of-the-mill traffic stop leads them to a surprising suspect.

videos.title: Crossing the Line
videos.overview: The murder of a new mother shocks a quiet community, especially when investigators learn that her estranged U.S. Army sergeant husband has an alibi; investigators find evidence of a love triangle involving a woman who is willing to cross the line.

videos.title: Dangerously Desperate
videos.overview: Police are stunned when two young men are gunned down in their backyard; investigators find a heartbroken lover and a web of lies concealing the truth.

videos.title: Blind Devotion
videos.overview: In Lubbock, Texas, detectives respond to an early-morning robbery-turned-homicide; they're not sure where to start looking for the killer, then a surveillance video and an anonymous tip lead them to a secret.

videos.title: Risking It All
videos.overview: Brazen armed robberies strike local businesses in a tranquil community in Wisconsin, and detectives find themselves with few clues to help them identify the perpetrators.

videos.title: Road to Trouble
videos.overview: A gifted high school cheerleader's plans for a bright future turn dark when she falls in love with an up-and-coming rapper and ex-convict.

videos.title: Led Astray by Love
videos.overview: A woman who is unlucky in love meets a smooth-talking older man and thinks she has finally found someone with whom to start a life.

videos.title: Fallen From Redemption
videos.overview: When a young woman is released from prison, she is determined to live her life on the straight and narrow; however, her efforts are derailed after she falls hard for a handsome stranger who drags her down into a dark place.

videos.title: Boy Next Door
videos.overview: A young mother gives up a life of security with a wholesome family man to live on the edge with the bad boy she cannot resist.

videos.title: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
videos.overview: When a God-fearing woman falls in love with a handsome ex-convict, he convinces her that his life of crime is behind him; he ropes her into helping him commit a double homicide, and she realizes she's in love with a wolf in sheep's clothing.

videos.title: Ruled By Love
videos.overview: A young lady is swept off her feet by an older man who spoils her with attention and gifts, but soon learns her new guy is actually the kingpin of an interstate drug operation.

videos.title: Conflicting Vows
videos.overview: A young woman joins the police force to provide a better life for her family, then she discovers her husband has been hanging around with some shady characters, and she is desperate to find out more.

videos.title: Facing The Music
videos.overview: Marsha Bernard catches the eye of a popular Jamaican dance-hall DJ; he gives her a life of luxury, and in return, she gives him undying loyalty and love.

videos.title: Driving Force
videos.overview: Jasha Howard has the world at her fingertips until a charming bad boy sweeps her off her feet.

videos.title: Patterns of Chaos
videos.overview: After escaping a bad relationship, a young woman thinks she has finally found Mr. Right; she quickly realizes her new man is actually worse than her ex.

videos.title: Master of Deception
videos.overview: A beautiful young bank teller falls head over heels for a starving musician; under his spell, she becomes willing to risk it all to help him rob the bank where she works.

videos.title: Along For The Ride
videos.overview: A young woman is looking for a fresh start when she falls for a handsome stranger and when her new man asks for her help in a dangerous plot to make some quick cash, she decides to risk it all for love.

videos.title: Illusion of Love
videos.overview: A young mother becomes so hypnotized by love that she loses sight of reality and gets herself involved in murder.

videos.title: Internal Battle
videos.overview: A teenage girl with a bright future has to decide how far she is willing to go for a bad boy who tries to pull her into his life of crime.

videos.title: Daily Consequences
videos.overview: A woman, consumed by love, must decide how far she will go for a man who promised her the world.

videos.title: Walking on the Wild Side
videos.overview: A savvy salon owner falls hard for a suave bad boy and agrees to help him run an escort service; things turn violent and she has to make a choice; let him keep his grip around her heart or take back her power and end it all.

videos.title: Larceny Hearts
videos.overview: An ambitious college student's man falls into the street life after losing his job, and he pulls her down with him; desperate to prove her devotion to him, she sacrifices not only her education but her freedom in the name of love.

videos.title: Chained by Love
videos.overview: A young dancer believes she's found her soul mate when she meets a handsome man who promises to make her a star; desperate to earn his love, she makes a deal with the devil; for a shot at the spotlight it will cost her body and her soul.

videos.title: Bloodshed and Betrayal
videos.overview: A single mom rekindles a relationship with her high school sweetheart after fate brings them together; their "happily ever after" is doomed when a risky idea to save their family ends in bloodshed; their loyalty to each other is tested.

videos.title: Young and Deadly
videos.overview: A young, aspiring actress falls madly in love with her older boss, and his toxic love manipulates her; she agrees to go down a dark and deadly path to prove her devotion to him.

videos.title: Teenage Mistake
videos.overview: A high school freshman falls in love for the first time when she meets an edgy troublemaker; she becomes desperate to show him her love has no bounds; she discovers there's a fine line between proving your love and going too far.

videos.title: Unholy Matrimony
videos.overview: A young woman who is committed to her faith is lured in by the idea of holy matrimony; she soon learns that her "man of God" is no saint; his violent temper leads her down a road of crime, abuse and destruction.

videos.title: The Bullets on Bourbon Street
videos.overview: A beautiful bartender believes she has found her soulmate when she is charmed by an up-and-coming rapper; when a fun night out takes a shockingly violent turn, she decides to put her man first and sacrifice everything to protect him.

videos.title: Blood is Thicker Than Water
videos.overview: After a painful divorce, a single mother didn't expect to ever love again; after a charming stranger wins her heart, she becomes desperate to do anything to keep her new man's love.

videos.title: By Any Means Necessary
videos.overview: A young woman finds solace in a new boyfriend after her father passes away; he ropes her into one of his criminal schemes; she finds herself in the midst of a brutal blood bath.

videos.title: Love and Lies
videos.overview: Sparks fly when a young mother reunites with her childhood crush, but her new man is guarding a deadly secret that will put her and her son's lives in danger; when she gets caught in the crosshairs, she must choose to save her man or herself.

videos.title: Man, or Monster?
videos.overview: A heartbreak sends a vivacious mother of seven into the arms of a wealthy gentleman; after nearly a decade together, she discovers the monster under the mask, a notorious gang leader being hunted by the FBI and leaving a trail of bodies behind him.

videos.title: Dancing with Danger
videos.overview: After a stint of living on the streets, a teenage girl finally finds security in the arms of her new boyfriend; in return, she'd do anything for him, but when a small favor takes a deadly turn, she loses her friend and her freedom, all for her man.

videos.title: Rooted in Revenge
videos.overview: After a loving mother and spiritualist meets her soul mate, they quickly start a happy life together; when a curse is threatening to destroy their marriage, the devoted wife will do anything to keep her man.

videos.title: Silent Lies
videos.overview: When a young mother starts a family with the man of her dreams, she believes nothing will tear them apart; when her man puts a child's life at risk, she has to choose between protecting the one she loves and listening to her maternal instincts.

videos.title: The Sting of Betrayal
videos.overview: A single mother meets a suave and loving provider, and she looks the other way when she learns the source of his income.

videos.title: Drive of Death
videos.overview: Sparks fly when a woman with a checkered past meets a man with a similar history, but old habits die hard; when her man falls back into a life of crime, she must decide to either follow her man into darkness or to finally do the right thing.

videos.title: Manipulation of Love
videos.overview: After meeting her Prince Charming on a dating service, a teen mother's dreams turn into a nightmare when she gets entangled in a twisted web of deceit and manipulation that will leave her to question how much love is truly worth sacrificing for.

videos.title: Three's A Crowd
videos.overview: A woman becomes part of the family when she falls in love with a widowed father; when the man's youngest son goes missing, everyone is pointing fingers; the investigation uncovers a sordid tale of jealousy and betrayal no one saw coming.

videos.title: Deadly Estrangement
videos.overview: After back-to-back tragedies have left her estranged from her family, a young woman finds the love and acceptance she'd always wished for, but when her man wants more for them, she'll be roped into a devilish plot to take back what she left behind.

videos.title: Demented Deception
videos.overview: When a young woman and the love of her life begin preparing a future together, they're struck by tragedy with a miscarriage; as the cracks between them begin to form, one woman will have to decide how far she'll go to create a perfect family.

videos.title: In Bad Faith
videos.overview: In January 2013, 24-year-old Carmisha Lay's reunion with her high school sweetheart, 28-year-old Edward Glenn Jr., ends in tragedy after what appears to be a robbery-gone-wrong; when investigators dive in deeper, they discover a devilish plot driven by the woman's desires to appease a new man.

videos.title: Blood Money
videos.overview: Chicago 2012: 23-year-old Loriana Johnson, desperate to live the life of the rich and famous and meets a promising young rapper, 24-year-old Qaw'mane Wilson aka Young QC; they fall madly in love and are willing to do what it takes to achieve their goal of wealth and success.

videos.title: A Family Affair
videos.overview: Atlanta 2003: When Lashundra Carr begins a family with the man of her dreams, Joseph Rayford, everything seems perfect; after an argument with their neighbor, college student 20-year-old Kareem Cowan, goes too far and threatens her new family, she'll be faced with protecting her man or risking everything she holds dear.

videos.title: Level of Loyalty
videos.overview: Baton Rouge 2012: 19-year-old college student Essence Dyson, a promising young woman with a passion for hip-hop finds her ride-or-die soulmate and a young up-and-coming rapper, 17-year-old Chattley Chesterfield aka Chad the Youngin; when a petty feud turns deadly, she'll l have to decide if she's all in for her man or if she's better off taking this ride alone.

videos.title: Nowhere to Run
videos.overview: Dallas 2017: When 27-year-old Ashley Coleman, a gifted new hip-hop artist, takes the Dallas club scene by storm, she falls under the spell of a hot young man, 17-year-old Hakeem Griffin White, who seems to embody the thug life underworld she vividly portrays in her art. His thug world soon pulls her down a deadly road after his former friend is gunned down in broad daylight.

videos.title: The Price of Revenge
videos.overview: Tulsa 2016: 25-year-old Mikaela Riddle, a young woman down on her luck, falls in love with an older man, 39-year-old Gerald Lowe, who swears to protect her; after a deadly encounter leaves a family member in critical condition, his protection may not be enough when his actions lead her down a deadly path.

videos.title: A Bitter Betrayal
videos.overview: Baltimore 2009: When 28-year-old mother Sherrell Ferguson reconnects with her childhood sweetheart, Markell Washington, nothing can stand in their way. But when her love is tested and she ends up in the middle of a homicide investigation, loyalty to her man may be what throws her under the bus.

videos.title: Deadly Dealings
videos.overview: Pittsburgh 2016: 24-year-old Erica Harris, a young woman dedicated to her boyfriend, 21-year-old Mitchell Coles, offers to help with an easy errand, but when the task doesn't go according to plan, her man decides to seek reparations. And when his plan wraps her into an investigation, will she find herself at a dead end?

videos.title: Path of Vengeance
videos.overview: Cleveland 2020: When 26-year-old Jannie Pace falls for handsome 28-year-old Toriano Williams, she believes she's found a man who will truly love and protect her. But when his protection comes with dire consequences, she'll have to weigh the cost of his security versus her own freedom.

videos.title: Bloody Money
videos.overview: A plot unfolds as love and desperation collide in 2017 in Detroit, MI; 26-year-old Amber Hunter and her husband, Javontae Wakefield, are driven to a gruesome act against her own mother, 41-year-old Tiffany Hunter, and a quest for cash.

videos.title: Vendetta
videos.overview: In Suffolk, VA, a romantic entanglement spirals into a trap; Dequanna Bates and Joshua Nickens' vendetta against Alan Moore leads to deadly consequences, as love blinds and dark intentions take over.

videos.title: Clubhouse Carnage
videos.overview: A flirtatious comment at a club leads Gina Conway and rapper boyfriend Max B into a setup in Fort Lee, NJ; their love story twists into a plot, culminating in the murder of David Taylor over jealousy and betrayal.

videos.title: Vengeance in Louisville
videos.overview: In an act of vengeance, Cheetara Goldsmith, driven by love and loss, shoots Makeba Lee, the girlfriend of her man's killer, in Louisville, KY; a tale of heartbreak morphs into a pursuit of retribution.

videos.title: Betrayal Bound
videos.overview: Patricia Jernigan, entangled in her boyfriend's manipulative schemes, targets a childhood friend in a robbery and kidnapping in Dearborn, MI; revealing depths of betrayal and coercion.

videos.title: Hip-Hop Heartbreak
videos.overview: Amid Chicago's gritty hip hop scene, Breanna Patterson's deep loyalty to Charles Smith leads to a disastrous home invasion; their twisted love results in a tragic confrontation, changing lives and ending dreams.

videos.title: Kin Killer
videos.overview: In a family betrayal, Terica Ellis aids her lover Tim Norman in orchestrating the shooting of his nephew, Andre 'Dre' Montgomery Jr., in St. Louis, MO; a web of deception and greed unravels, proving fatal.

videos.title: Jealousy's Fatal Strike
videos.overview: Driven by jealousy in a fraught love triangle, Gabrielle Brantley's actions tragically end the life of KaBria Arnold, a pregnant aspiring nurse in Detroit, MI; a toxic blend of love and betrayal culminates in irreversible loss.

videos.title: Reckless Love Rampage
videos.overview: Sharae Threadgill and Jalen Benton launch a three-day crime spree across state lines, culminating in the killing of Philip Whitaker in Columbus, GA; their wild journey ends in multiple arrests.

videos.title: Love's Lethal Lies
videos.overview: In a grim bid to protect her man, Tiaira Miller finds herself embroiled in deceit after Gregory Jones murders his pregnant ex, single mom Kenyatta McCurry; in South Bend, OR, her tangled web of lies and hidden evidence leads to a tragic unraveling.

videos.title: Loyalty's Deadly Price
videos.overview: In La Crosse, WI, Brittany Jones' rush to aid her boyfriend Mitrel Anderson, after a violent encounter with his childhood friend DeMario Lee, plunges her into a legal nightmare, with loyalty leading to harsh consequences.

videos.title: Fatal Jealousy
videos.overview: Caught in a manipulative love triangle, 28-year-old pregnant single mom Shamiya Todd's jealousy is influenced by her ex-husband Christopher Mitchell's deceit. The love triangle turns deadly when Christopher's girlfriend, 18-year-old Shania James, is fatally shot while all 3 are in Shamiya's home in Las Vegas, NV.

videos.title: New Year's Day Slay
videos.overview: Driven by fury in a bitter love triangle, 33-year-old Nadiyah Whitaker, a single mom and LPN, fatally shoots 30-year-old single mom Shanna Mason on New Year's Day in Buffalo, NY, as betrayal and deception ignite a deadly confrontation.

videos.title: Silencing for Love
videos.overview: Brianna Smith's love for Romando Williams leads her into a plan to silence a rival; blinded by her devotion, she helps Romando carry out a serious plan, but the price of loyalty proves too high; will Brianna's love cost her everything?

videos.title: Lured by Loyalty
videos.overview: Terreona Horton's love for Lydell Sparks leads her to participate in a fatal ambush; blinded by her loyalty, she lures an innocent man into a trap, sealing her fate.

videos.title: Deadly Demands
videos.overview: Daja Giles' love for Kalius Lane drags her into a deadly confrontation; when jealousy leads to murder, Daja must choose between her loyalty and her future.

videos.title: Fatal Devotion
videos.overview: Zuri London's devotion to a man on trial for murder pushes her to extreme lengths; she helps him flee from justice, thinking love will protect them.

videos.title: Ride of Die Sacrifice
videos.overview: Melissa Rios Roque's love for Kelsey McFoley drags her into a deadly scheme; to protect him from prison, Melissa helps orchestrate a murder-for-hire plot.

videos.title: The Cost of Survival
videos.overview: Ciara Williams thought Dennis Power was her stability, but as his temper flares, their love turns to violence; when a fatal confrontation ends in bloodshed, Ciara must face the devastating consequences of a toxic love gone wrong.

videos.title: Deadly Devotion
videos.overview: Jasmine Rivera's love for Tonie Future draws her into a deadly gang murder; she helps cover up the crime, unaware that her loyalty will lead her down a path of destruction.

videos.title: The Cost of Obsession
videos.overview: Tiara Burnett's devotion to Quinn James pulls her into a dark world; when he commits a heinous crime, Tiara helps cover up the murder in the name of love.

videos.title: Bound by Betrayal
videos.overview: Katrina Griffin's love for Floyd Hose leads her into a dangerous spiral; when he ropes her into a bank robbery, Katrina's loyalty turns into a crime spree that risks everything.

videos.title: Shattered Loyalties
videos.overview: Brandi Davis grew up with wealth, but it came from a dangerous source; her love for a high-profile drug dealer pulls her into the criminal world her father built.

videos.title: Web of Deception
videos.overview: Noriella Santos is drawn into Daniel Greenspan's dangerous world; blinded by love, she helps set up a murder in the name of loyalty; as her role in the crime is revealed, Noriella must face the devastating consequences of her devotion.

videos.title: Shattered Trust
videos.overview: Brittany's love for Antonio Hamm led her into a nightmare of manipulation and violence. Drawn into his deadly schemes, a brutal crime shattered her world, forcing Brittany to choose between loyalty to a manipulative partner and her own survival.

videos.title: Love, Power and BMF
videos.overview: As the first lady of BMF, Tonesa Welch's devotion to Harold Mills and Terry Flenory drives her deeper into a dangerous world of crime and betrayal . Her loyalty to the men she loves comes at a deadly cost.

videos.title: Beyond Reason
videos.overview: After immigrating to America, a single mother starts a life hoping to find love. Her years-long search finally leads to her true soulmate, but when her happily ever after is threatened, how far is she willing to go to keep the man of her dreams?

videos.title: Addicted to Love
videos.overview: Blinded by love and addiction, Laura Walton follows Deon Batton down a path of armed robbery and deception. When the law catches up, she realizes the price of devotion can be life-changing.

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: A young Louisiana woman falls for a man who promises her the world, but his volatile behavior quickly pulls her into a dangerous web of secrets. Torn between loyalty and the law, she must make an impossible choice that will change her life.

videos.title: Escape for Love
videos.overview: Kendra Miller is a mother of four and corrections officer who falls for a convicted killer and helps him escape; their secret romance ignites a statewide manhunt, as Kendra risks everything for her man.

videos.title: Ambush on Ash Street
videos.overview: A young mother meets the man of her dreams, but just a few months into her relationship, she learns that her desire to have the perfect family may come at too high a cost. Soon she is forced to choose between protecting her man and saving herself.

videos.title: Deadly Love Triangle
videos.overview: Alexis Holmes' love for Eddie Robinson blinds her to his manipulation. When jealousy over her longtime friend Champ spirals out of control, Alexis is forced to choose sides leading to a shocking crime of passion.

videos.title: Boundless Love
videos.overview: A successful woman with a bright future falls under the spell of a charming but dangerous man. What begins as infatuation quickly spirals into a dangerous loyalty leading her to partake in a violent plot to silence a key witness against him.

videos.title: A Mother's Mistake
videos.overview: April Coger wanted love; Kenneth Chaney offered danger. Drawn into his world of crime, her devotion leads to a violent spree, a fatal end, and a reckoning she never saw coming.

videos.title: Stolen Innocence
videos.overview: When a bright young woman with nursing career aspirations falls for a sweet-talking bad boy, he takes her for a walk on the wild side. He lands them both in hot water and she must choose between the future she wanted or a future with her man.

videos.title: In His Line of Fire
videos.overview: Desperate to keep Aaron Mays close, Gitano Lewis spirals into a deadly plot of revenge and betrayal. Her loyalty leads her straight into gunfire and costs an innocent man his life.

videos.title: Deadly Affair
videos.overview: A young and determined certified nurse's assistant with a traumatic past stumbles upon love for the first time. When her partner's affair test the limits of their relationship, how far will she go to protect the bond she cherishes most?

videos.title: The Setup
videos.overview: When Antonetta Stevens learns her fiancé is cheating, she plots revenge. With her 17-year-old sister-in-law by her side, she lures his lover into a deadly ambush. What she does for her man changes everything.

videos.title: Caught in the Middle
videos.overview: A young wife and mother becomes entangled in a murder investigation when her lover goes on a killing rampage and starts a war with the local police department, forcing her to choose between risking it all to protect him or losing him forever.

videos.title: Textbook Betrayal
videos.overview: Destynie Wright's love for Ramon Boyd pulls her into a deadly web of lies. One fateful night, a string of texts triggers a shooting that leaves her best friend wounded and a young man dead.

videos.title: Out of Time
videos.overview: When her marriage to NBA superstar Lorenzen Wright fizzles, a mother of six struggles to rebuild her life and find love again. But when a new man suddenly sweeps her off her feet, how far will she go to guarantee that her second chance at love doesn't slip away?

videos.title: Blinded by Loyalty
videos.overview: Torn between an old flame and her new man, Tyricka Woullard chooses love over reason. When Darryl Mack demands loyalty, she helps lure Tavish Greene into a trap - one that ends in murder.

videos.title: Fatal Error
videos.overview: A young mother Falls for a dangerous man who leads her down a path of deception, desperation and violence. When he's accused of murder, she must choose: turn in the man she loves or risk everything to protect him as the police close in on them both.

videos.title: The Last Ride
videos.overview: Telisha Williams falls for Javonta Williams, but love turns risky when she lies to cover his tracks. As their story unravels and the truth begins to surface, her false alibi drags her into a storm of consequences she never saw coming.
